question:
Refer to the following number and symbol series and answer the question that follows. Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 7 $ 5 @ 3 ! 3 5 6 7 & % $ 3 # 2 7 + ? > < (Right)

If all the numbers are dropped from the series, which of the following will be the seventh from the right?
solution:
**Given:** (Left) 7 $ 5 @ 3 ! 3 5 6 7 & % $ 3 # 2 7 + ? > < (Right)

After dropping all the numbers, the remaining series is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e495887935789a08dd521edc1522a1bdd0aa9ace1129d522db19e4485baa52c.png] 

Thus, % is the seventh symbol from the right.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 3**".
